company_policy: Displays over 55 inches need two technicians. Sellers do not own delivery tasks. Hardware prices are the reseller's, not ours.
_note: Entirely invented. No customer text: names, sites, numbers and wording are made up to exercise every part of the contract.

atoms.text: Hi team, thanks for the quick call yesterday!

label.note: Greeting with no fact about the work.

atoms.text: We need wall-mounted displays installed at our three clinics: Bayview, Cedar Hill and Linden.

label.note:
The job in one line: wall-mount displays at 3 clinics (Bayview, Cedar Hill, Linden). Sets the site count at 3, later cut to 2.
[purtera] keep: opens the Deal Kit scope.

atoms.text: Each clinic gets four 65" displays in the waiting room.

label.note:
Quantity and size per site: 4 displays at 65 inches each, so 3 sites x 4 = 12 displays. A 65 inch panel is a two-person lift.
[purtera] keep: over 55 inches, so 2 techs per mount.

atoms.text: Is there power and blocking behind the waiting room walls?

label.note: Asks whether the walls have power and blocking. The answer decides whether an electrician and backing plates are added before the mounts.

atoms.text: Our account rep will send the hardware quote by Friday.

reads_set.commitment: send the hardware quote by Friday

label.note:
A promise to send the hardware quote by Friday, owned by the seller. It sets no delivery work.
[purtera] reject: sellers do not own delivery tasks.

atoms.text: Power is there at every location; walls are steel stud with no blocking.

label.note: Answers the power and blocking question: power exists, but steel studs without blocking mean backing plates at every mount, which adds install time per display.

atoms.text: Update: Linden is closing, so only Bayview and Cedar Hill.

label.note: Cuts the site count from 3 to 2 (Linden out). Every quantity derived from 3 sites changes: 2 x 4 = 8 displays.

atoms.text: Statement of Work - Scope of Work

label.note: Heading that opens the SOW scope list; it governs the scope lines under it.

atoms.text: Install eight (8) 65" displays across two (2) locations, including backing plates.

label.note: SOW scope: 8 displays over 2 sites with backing plates, worked out as 2 sites x 4 = 8 from the site cut and the per-site count, and the plates from the steel-stud answer.
Labor estimate: 2 techs x 8 hours = 16 hours, one day per site for 2 sites. Rests on 8 displays at about 2 hours each including plates.

atoms.text: Fees: 16 hours x $95 = $1,520, billed time and materials.

label.note:
Labor fee: 16 hours x $95 = $1,520 on a time and materials basis, so the total is an estimate of hours times rate.
[purtera] keep: matches the Deal Kit labor line.

Reseller hardware line: 8 displays at 65 inches. The quantity agrees with the SOW's 8.
[purtera] reject: hardware prices are the reseller's; quantity and size are kept for crew planning.
Site 1 of 2: Bayview at 410 Harbor Rd, Port Alder. Street address without ZIP, enough to dispatch.

Site 2 of 2: Cedar Hill, city only (Port Alder). A street address is still needed before a tech can be dispatched.
[purtera] keep: intake gap, the address should have been asked at quoting.
